suggested_response_draft: I'm sorry to hear you were charged twice this month - that's frustrating and we want to get it corrected. I'm flagging this for our billing team to investigate the duplicate charge right away. We'll follow up with you as soon as we have an update.

I'm sorry your app crashed while uploading a large CSV - that's a frustrating experience. I'm passing this along to our engineering team to investigate the crash with files over 10MB. We'll keep you posted on what we find.

Happy to help you add a teammate to your workspace! You can do this from your workspace settings under the 'Members' or 'Team' tab. If you don't see that option, let us know and we'll walk you through it.

I completely understand your frustration - running into repeated bugs is not the experience we want for you, and I don't want cancelling to feel like the only option. I'm escalating this to our team so we can look into what's been going wrong. We appreciate you giving us the chance to make this right.

You can download your invoice from the Billing section of your account settings. Look for the 'Invoices' or 'Billing history' tab, where each invoice has a download link. Let us know if you can't locate it there.

Sorry you're having trouble resetting your password - that's an important thing to get working quickly. I'm looking into what might be blocking the reset process on our end. We'll follow up with more details soon.

Thanks for flagging this - I understand wanting billing to reflect your actual seat usage. I'm looking into your account to see why you were billed for two seats. We'll get back to you with a clear explanation.

Sorry to hear CSV export is broken again - I know this isn't the first time, and that's frustrating. I'm flagging this to our engineering team so they can dig into what's causing the repeated failures. We'll update you as we learn more.
Switching from monthly to annual billing is easy - you can do this from the Billing section of your account settings by selecting 'Change plan.' Let us know if you run into any issues along the way.

I hear you, and I appreciate you sharing this honestly rather than just leaving. I'd like to understand more about where our support has been falling short so we can address it directly. I'm looping in our team to follow up with you personally.

Sorry about the incorrect company name on your invoice - that's an easy thing to get wrong and important to fix. I'm passing this to our billing team so they can correct it. We'll let you know once it's updated.

Sorry the dashboard is stuck on a loading spinner - that's frustrating when you're trying to get work done. I'm flagging this to our engineering team to investigate. We'll follow up with what we find.

Setting up SSO for your team is something we can definitely help with. You'll find the SSO configuration options under Workspace Settings > Security. If you'd like, we can also point you to our detailed setup guide.
I understand wanting a refund when usage was low - thanks for reaching out about this. I'm passing your request along to our billing team for review. They'll follow up with you directly.

Sorry to hear the Slack integration broke after our recent update - that's not what we want happening. I'm flagging this to our engineering team to look into what changed. We'll keep you updated on progress.

Great question - the Pro and Business plans differ mainly in team size limits, advanced permissions, and priority support. I'd be happy to send over a full comparison if that would help you decide. Just let us know!

I'm really sorry about the outages this quarter - that kind of reliability issue is serious and I understand why you're evaluating alternatives. I'm escalating this to our leadership team so we can talk through what happened and how we're addressing it. We'd like the chance to speak with you directly.
Sorry about the currency issue on your invoice - that's not right and we want to fix it. I'm passing this along to our billing team to correct the charge. We'll follow up once it's resolved.
You can remove a teammate from your workspace under Workspace Settings > Members by selecting the teammate and choosing 'Remove.' Let us know if you need a hand with the steps.

Sorry you're getting logged out repeatedly - that's disruptive and not expected behavior. I'm flagging this to our engineering team to investigate what's causing the session drops. We'll update you as we learn more.
Happy to explain the annual discount! It applies a percentage off your total plan cost when you commit to yearly billing instead of monthly. Let us know if you'd like the exact numbers for your plan.

I'm really sorry your team is blocked and this has become urgent - that's not acceptable and I understand your frustration. I'm escalating this immediately so we can get eyes on the issue and speak with you directly. We want the chance to fix this before you make a decision.

I'm sorry this is the second time you've seen a duplicate charge - that's a serious billing issue and we want to make sure it's corrected. I'm escalating this to our billing team right away to investigate and prevent it from happening again. We'll follow up with you as soon as possible.

Sorry the search feature isn't returning results for valid queries - that's clearly not working as it should. I'm flagging this to our engineering team to dig into what's going wrong. We'll keep you posted on progress.
You can export your data from Account Settings > Data Export before your trial ends. If you'd like, we can also walk you through preserving your account details ahead of the deadline.

Thank you for being honest about how close the confusing onboarding came to costing us your business - that's valuable feedback and I take it seriously. I'm passing this along to our product team so we can improve the experience for others. I'd also love to hear more directly about what tripped you up, if you're open to it.

Sorry about the incorrect renewal date showing on your billing page - that's confusing and we want to get it right. I'm flagging this to our billing team to correct it. We'll follow up once it's fixed.

Sorry your file upload is failing without any error message - that's especially frustrating when there's no indication of what went wrong. I'm flagging this to our engineering team to investigate. We'll update you as we learn more.
You can set custom permissions for a teammate under Workspace Settings > Members > Permissions. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the available permission levels.

I'm sorry to hear the frequency of bugs has you considering a move to a competitor - that's serious feedback and I don't want to lose your business over avoidable issues. I'm escalating this to our team so we can address the recurring problems directly. I'd also welcome the chance to talk with you before your renewal.
